use.flag: Install net-misc/rmapi to access the reMarkable cloud

Install app-text/rmc to convert .rm notebooks to SVG/PDF/Markdown, app-text/pdf2rmnotebook to turn PDFs into editable notebooks, and (amd64 only) app-text/remarks to extract highlights and annotations
Install mod development tools: dev-util/qmldiff and (amd64 only) dev-util/vbuild; the SDK (dev-embedded/remarkable-sdk-bin) is separate
Install app-misc/codexctl (amd64 only) to download, inspect and switch tablet firmware
Install the desktop apps app-misc/remanager, app-misc/remarkable-remember and (amd64 only) app-misc/rm-exporter-bin
Install x11-misc/remarkable-mouse (X11) and x11-misc/remarkable-tablet-driver (Wayland) to use the tablet as a pen tablet
Install app-text/goosepaper (amd64 only) to generate daily newspapers for the tablet
Install app-office/ephemeris (amd64 only) to generate daily planner PDFs from ICS calendars
Install media-gfx/resnap to take screenshots of the tablet
Install net-misc/rmfakecloud, a self-hosted cloud server
Install media-video/restream to stream the tablet screen
Install app-misc/rmirro for cloud-free two-way file sync
